text:
Maria S (Support): Hey team, incoming escalation from AcmeCorp — their embeddings workload to eu-west is failing with lots of 400 errors and spikes in latency since last night. They say some calls return "dimension mismatch" and others are just super slow (5-10s). They attached a curl repro.

Alex O (Oncall): Copy. Can you paste the repro here and any sample headers? Also, are they using our hosted embeddings endpoint or dedicated?

Maria S (Support): Hosted. Repro curl they used: 
```
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/embeddings \
  -H 'Authorization: Bearer sk-REDACTED' \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -d '{"model":"embed-redwood-large","input":"hello world"}'
```
Response seen: 400 "embedding vector size mismatch: expected 1536 but got 768" in ~30% of requests. Other requests succeed but take 5-8s.

Jyoti (ML Eng): That error suggests the model variant returning 768-d vectors (probably a smaller quantized variant) while the client expects 1536. Could be routing to a different model family or a GPU spin-up fallback. Did they pin model version?

Maria S (Support): They did not pin version. They called model name `embed-redwood-large` (no version). They expect eu-west region. Their request URL is `https://api.redwood.ai/v1/embeddings` (no region subdomain).

Sam R (Router): Hmm — by default we route to region by customer org mapping, but we also have dynamic spillover to other regions if capacity is constrained. I'm seeing recent changes in routing thresholds overnight for embeddings. I'll pull the routing logs for AcmeCorp. Give me a minute.

ops-bot: [route-log] 1900004335 AcmeCorp org-id=org-ACME request_id=xx123 route=eu-west-1 handler=embed-node-42 variant=embed-redwood-large-v1 capacity=ok
ops-bot: [route-log] 1900004338 AcmeCorp org-id=org-ACME request_id=xx124 route=us-east-1 handler=embed-small-09 variant=embed-redwood-small-v2 capacity=spillover

Alex O (Oncall): Aha. Some requests routed to `us-east-1` and hit `embed-redwood-small-v2` which returns 768 vectors. That would explain the dimension mismatch and the higher latency (cross-region). Why would routing spillover to a smaller variant?

Sam R (Router): Initial hypothesis: eu-west pool for `embed-redwood-large` saturated -> our smart routing spilled over to a cheaper/smaller variant in us-east to maintain availability. That fallback path wasn't tested for cross-compatibility (dimension). We should treat this as a bug: we must not fall back to a model with different vector dims without translation.

Jyoti (ML Eng): Agreed. Additionally cold-starts in us-east when handling spilled traffic could cause the 5-8s latency. We should check whether we attempted to warm compatible replicas before routing.

Maria S (Support): Customer wants immediate mitigation. They just want embeddings in eu-west, same shape. Any temporary workaround we can offer?

Alex O (Oncall): Short-term: 1) Advise customer to pin a specific model version that we guarantee in eu-west (e.g., `embed-redwood-large@2025-11-03`) so requests are routed to the right variant. 2) We can enable a per-org routing override to force region=eu-west for AcmeCorp while we fix the fallback behavior.

Sam R (Router): I can push a routing override for org-ACME to eu-west for the next 24h. Doing it now...

ops-bot: [route-change] 1900004370 override set org-ACME region=eu-west expires=1900080770 changed_by=SamR

Maria S (Support): I told the customer to pin model version and that we set a temporary override. They confirmed reduced errors but still see occasional 3s cold-starts for some batches.

Jyoti (ML Eng): For long-term: we need to update routing logic to 1) only fall back to models with identical embedding dims, or 2) perform on-the-fly projection/upsampling with a documented behavior (but that can degrade quality). Also add a pre-warm path before cross-region spillover.

Alex O (Oncall): Also assign an incident ticket to eng-runtime and eng-router. We need an RCA if this spilled over because of a capacity regression, and a patch to prevent mismatched-dim fallbacks.

Sam R (Router): Filed ENG-5643 (routing spillover -> wrong-dim fallback). Assigning to @Jyoti for model compatibility checks and to @alex_oncall for rollout/autoscale policy review.

Jyoti (ML Eng): I'll add tests ensuring that routing candidates for embeddings must have identical output dimension. Also will add an alert when >0% requests for an org hit a different-dim variant.

Maria S (Support): Customer asked for repro steps they can run. Suggested curl to surface routing headers: 
```
curl -v -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/embeddings \
  -H 'Authorization: Bearer sk-REDACTED' \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -H 'X-Redwood-Client-Region: eu-west-1' \
  -d '{"model":"embed-redwood-large","input":"test embedding list"}'
```
Then look at response headers: `x-redwood-region`, `x-redwood-model`, and `x-emb-dim`. If `x-redwood-region` != `eu-west-1` or `x-emb-dim` != `1536` they should stop traffic and contact support.

Alex O (Oncall): Good. Also add to the support playbook: if dimension mismatch error occurs, set org routing override, advise customer to pin model version, and escalate to ENG.

Sam R (Router): Quick status: override in place. I'm also pushing a short-term change to the router to reject fallback to models with incompatible `embedding_dim` until we have projection code. Rolling change to canary now.

ops-bot: [deploy] 1900004410 router-canary v2.7.1 -> hosts: router-canary-03 status=starting
ops-bot: [deploy] 1900004432 router-canary v2.7.1 -> hosts: router-canary-03 status=healthy

Jyoti (ML Eng): Once canary is healthy, please roll to production. I'll run unit tests and integration tests to ensure no regressions.

Alex O (Oncall): I'll communicate back to AcmeCorp with the plan and ETA for a permanent fix (next week) plus the temporary override. Maria, can you send a short summary for the customer with the remedial steps and ticket links?

Maria S (Support): Yep — sending now. Summary includes: repro curl with headers, temporary override, pin model version, and ENG ticket ENG-5643. Customer replied: "Thanks — errors dropped from ~20% to ~1% after override. We'll pin the version. Please keep us posted." :thumbsup:

Sam R (Router): Follow-ups for eng: 1) prevent cross-dim fallbacks, 2) pre-warm compatible replicas before cross-region routing, 3) improve observability: emit `x-emb-dim` header on all responses, 4) alert when >0.5% of an org's requests go cross-region.

Jyoti (ML Eng): I'll own compat tests and the projection proposal doc. ETA for patch to router: 3 business days after canary validation.

Alex O (Oncall): Closing the support thread for now. Reopen if customer sees reoccurrence. Thanks everyone.

Maria S (Support): Closing notes: workaround applied, customer happy for now, ENG tickets filed.
